recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create **Legend of the Verdant Sigil**, a browser-native portrait mobile top-down action RPG survival game. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: joystick movement, canvas tap light attack, held heavy attack, roll button with cooldown and short invulnerability, enemies spawning from edges and chasing with variants, contact damage, HP defeat, loot/rupee rewards, weapon unlock thresholds, and restart overlay.

Reinterpret the loop as Zelda RPG adventure with mythic overworld exploration, puzzle dungeons, item-gated progression, hidden secrets, heroic questing, environmental puzzle-solving, boss encounters, legendary fantasy tone, and portrait-first mobile controls. The player is a green-capped heroic wanderer cleansing a forest shrine. Enemies are mythic shades and dungeon creatures. Drops are Deku Seeds, Forest Keys, and Sage Runes. Score is Rupees; power level is Courage; weapons are legendary fantasy blades and tools. Use procedural canvas art, animated shrine flooring, leaves/fireflies, runic panels, strong mobile HUD readability, and touch-friendly controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile-first top-down arena action RPG survival loop.
- objective: Move a hero around a full-screen canvas, fight incoming enemies, collect dropped resources, unlock stronger weapons, survive escalating waves, and restart on defeat.
- input model: Virtual joystick for movement, tap canvas for light attack, hold right action for heavy attack, roll button for dash/evade, satchel button for inventory/equipment, keyboard fallbacks for desktop.
- core loop: Spawn enemies at screen edges, chase player, player attacks in facing direction, enemy contact damages hearts, defeated enemies grant rupees/resources, rupees increase courage/health, kill thresholds unseal weapons, wave increases over time.
- fail/friction state: HP reaches zero, game-over overlay shows run stats and restart CTA.

## Protected mechanics
- Preserve movement speed scaling, joystick semantics, tap/hold attack semantics, roll distance/cooldown/invulnerability, enemy spawn cadence/escalation, contact collision damage, attack cone/range hit detection, loot/resource counts, weapon unlock thresholds, rupee-to-level scaling, game-over and restart semantics.

## Remixed target
Zelda RPG adventure with mythic overworld exploration, puzzle dungeons, item-gated progression, hidden secrets, heroic questing, environmental puzzle-solving, boss encounters, legendary fantasy tone, and portrait-first mobile controls. The preserved arena combat becomes a heroic shrine-cleansing quest: a green-capped wanderer explores a living overworld shrine, banishes Stalfos/Wolfos/Wizzrobe-like threats, gathers Deku Seeds/Forest Keys/Sage Runes, earns Rupees/Courage, and unseals legendary blades.
